description: All students in Kindergarten through 2nd grade will take part in an annual universal screening to identify reading difficulties, including dyslexia. Parents can opt their child out by submitting a written request to the school principal by April 24, 2026.

name: Castillero Athletic Booster Club

name: Castillero Music Booster Club Fundraiser
description: Support Our CMBC Program – Sweeten Easter & Mother's Day! We've partnered with See's Candies once again to bring you delicious, high-quality chocolates just in time for Easter and Mother's Day. All sales from this storefront will support instruments, sheet music, and performance opportunities for our students—and we'd love your support!

name: Yearbook Deadline
description: If you haven't purchased the yearbook, please purchase it before April 20th. No yearbooks will be sold once they are distributed.

name: Family Fun Night at The Kebab Shop
description: Show this flyer when ordering in store or use code FUNDRAISER for online orders and 25% of sales will go the PTA!
location: The Kebab Shop- 5110 Cherry Ave Ste 30

name: Reading Lab Volunteers Needed
description: The Reading Lab is a tutoring program for students who would benefit from extra help with fundamental reading skills. We are looking for volunteers who can come in once per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday) during the school year. Training for new tutors is provided!! Helping these new & growing readers is super fun and rewarding!

name: PTA Board Elections
description: We are looking for members of our Los Alamitos community to join our PTA Executive Board for 2026-27 school year! The current slate for the 2026-2027 school year will be voted on at our next general meeting on April 27th.
